ICALS 2027

The conference is technically co-sponsored by the IEEE Computer Society. Accepted papers will be submitted to IEEE Xplore and indexed by DBLP and Scopus.

Important Dates

Paper Submission DeadlineJanuary 20, 2027 (extended from December 15, 2026)
Notification of AcceptanceMarch 10, 2027
Camera-Ready SubmissionApril 5, 2027

Registration fee: USD 650 regular, USD 350 students.
